exchanges: so thanksgiving at my place this year and i'm already regretting volunteering lol
Hosting is a lot! What's making you regret it?
the food. my dad went vegan last year and won't shut up about it
That narrows the menu a bit, but there are lots of good plant-based sides.
ya i know, its fine. but then there's my stepdad gary
Uh oh, what's his situation?
he's doing keto, so basically meat and cheese and nothing else. him and my dad at the same table is going to be a comedy show
That's quite the menu challenge. You might need a few dishes that work for both.
is there anything that works for both??
Roasted vegetables like Brussels sprouts or cauliflower can fit both, depending on what you add.
ok thats something
It's a start. A big salad helps too.
my half sister chloe is coming home from mcgill for it, she's in her second year
That's nice, she must be looking forward to a home-cooked meal.
she's bringing her roommate who's never had thanksgiving before, she's from france
Fun, she'll get the full experience.
lol hopefully a good one
With a comedy show at the table, it'll be memorable at least.
my aunt rosa is a nurse and she's working the night before so she'll be tired but she's coming
Good of her to make it after a night shift.
she always brings tamales, it's tradition at this point
Tamales at Thanksgiving sounds like a great tradition.
honestly the best part
Hard to compete with that.
oh and the neighbours, hassan and zainab, just had their baby, a little girl named aisha. i'm thinking of bringing them a plate
That's very kind. New parents rarely have time to cook.
they've been so nice to us since we moved here
Sounds like a good way to return the favour.
hassan drives me to the train when my car's in the shop, in his old camry
That's a generous neighbour.
gary is a realtor so he keeps trying to tell hassan what his house is worth lol
That sounds like an awkward conversation waiting to happen.
so awkward
Maybe seat them apart.
lol good idea
Seating charts can save a lot of trouble.
ok i messed up, the baby is amira, not aisha. aisha is zainab's sister. i should not be writing a card today
Good thing you caught it before the card.
seriously lol
Easy mistake when you're juggling this many people.
ok so how big a turkey for like 12 people
Around 15 to 18 pounds should do it, with some leftovers.
even tho dad wont eat any
Your stepdad will probably make up for him.
lmaoo true
It balances out.
ok what about dessert
Pumpkin pie is classic, and you could do a fruit crisp with a dairy-free topping too.
my cousin diego said he'd bring something but he's surfing in tofino till the day before so who knows
He might show up with a store-bought pie, which is still fine.
honestly thats all i want from him
Low expectations make for a relaxed host.
exactly. ok im gonna make a shopping list
Good plan, start with the turkey and work from there.

hassan and zainab's baby is aisha right
what's diego up to before the holiday
what does hassan do for work
